scope: Button grids, a picture button, a spinner, a configured picture popup menu, an editable picture and a splitter in an area-owned form: roles, labels, cell order and layout, stable paths, presses through each control's own On Clicked, a picture popup cell chosen from the plugin's menu through 4D's palette, picture Paste, Copy, Clear and Cut through 4D's standard actions and the field's After Edit, VoiceOver navigation and activation

environment.compiler: 4D Server 20.8 Compile project, arm64_macOS_lib and x86_64_generic

pixels: Each AX run compares the form, before any action, with the same window built without plugin, component or helpers: zero changed pixels below the title bar, excluding the continuously animated spinner.

notCovered: Picture popup menus in list boxes, list subforms or with the gotoPage standard action
Picture drag and drop, formats and the picture context menu's other commands
clipboard: Each run saves the whole general pasteboard before launch and restores it after; the fixture puts its sample picture there at startup.

retainedFailures.observation: One VoiceOver run in the full matrix failed a speech check; VoiceOver was reading a button's usage hint when the expected phrase was due. Two immediate reruns of the same mode passed all checks; the passing run is recorded.
